reason: The hypothesis restates the exact material system, processing method, microalloying element, and the dual wear/corrosion mechanism reported in P1 and P2, including the optimal content and the trade-off at higher B levels. The predicted outcome and boundary conditions are taken directly from the findings of P1 and P11, and the overall idea is the same as the future work proposed in P2. No new alloy, regime, or mechanistic link beyond P1 is introduced.
